punchline: The robot the hotel guests met was a stand-in steered with a PlayStation controller.
thirty_sec: In May 2014 John Zeratsky ran a week-long sprint at Savioke, a Sunnyvale company making a hotel delivery robot. Instead of a finished machine, the team built a stand-in in about a day, steered with a laptop and a PlayStation controller. On Friday it delivered toothbrushes to real guests at a hotel. They were enthusiastic, and some took selfies. The robot entered service about three weeks later.
